column1: # Commits credited to the GitHub user who submitted the pull request that carried them, one row per
# exact commit. Their author email is a placeholder or an address no GitHub account is linked to,
# so it gets no emails/ file: that would credit every commit with the address, past and future, to
# this login. The Contributor Attribution Check accepts a commit listed here (same sha, same author
# email); any other commit with that email still needs a mapping. Source: GitHub's pull requests
